title: Interstage pack
description: Scaffold plugins/interstage-<name>/ with a first skill and list it in the marketplace catalog.

name.description: Pack name without the interstage- prefix (kebab-case); the plugin is interstage-<name>.
name.x-prompt: Pack name, without the interstage- prefix?

description.description: Pack description for package.json and the marketplace catalog (one line, at most 300 characters).

skill.description: Name of the pack's first skill without the is- prefix; defaults to the pack name.

skillDescription.description: Trigger statement of the first skill (at most 1024 characters, one line).
skillDescription.x-prompt: Trigger statement for the first skill?

budgetBytes.description: SKILL.md size target of the first skill recorded in skills.manifest.json.
